For a 9 500 € bathroom renovation, with a quote already in hand and funds needed within a few weeks, the suitable financing is the **Expresso Loan**: it is an amortising personal loan, not earmarked for a specific purchase, which suits home improvements well, and it requires no proof of purchase.

On the schedule, this product provides for the funds to be made available within a minimum of **8 days** after approval: your horizon of a few weeks is therefore compatible, subject to review of the case file.

For the costing, I can give it to you based on the current rates for 9 500 €. Simply tell me the term you are considering (the loan runs from 12 to 84 months) and I will present the monthly payment, total cost and total amount due, as an indicative simulation.

One point of vigilance about your situation: you already have a loan monthly payment of around 956 € per month, for an average income of around 4 800 € and savings capacity of around 928 € per month. A moderate additional monthly payment should remain sustainable, but it will reduce your monthly margin accordingly — hence the importance of calibrating the term.

If you would prefer a solution with an available reserve and very fast disbursement (48 h), the **Alterna Revolving Credit** also exists, but its rate is significantly higher: for a one-off, clearly identified need such as yours, the amortising loan remains more cost-effective.

| Term | Monthly payment | Fixed APR | Total cost | Total due |

| 36 months | 287 € | 5.90% | 10 332 € | 10 332 € |

To stay under 400 €, the 36-month term is the shortest that works: monthly payment of around **287 €**, i.e. a total cost of around 10 332 € (around 832 € of interest). The fixed annual borrowing rate is not provided in the data I have; the APR above is the reference rate, excluding application fees and optional insurance.

A monthly payment of 287 € therefore remains sustainable, but it uses up nearly a third of your monthly margin — especially since your available savings (around 14 700 €) cover your project, which opens up another option.

Two levers, to be decided according to your priority:
- **Prioritise cost**: use part of your savings to reduce the amount borrowed, which lowers the monthly payment without stretching the term.
- **Prioritise preserving your savings**: stay on 36 months at 287 €, keeping your reserve intact.
